surface.method: Twist-resolved skeletal IK; anatomical torso, neck and foot frames; neutral distal hands/head; bounded limb fitting; SO(3) display filtering followed by fresh skinning
surface.scope: Display retargeting only. Native motion features, source joints and original timing retained. Not an experimental motion-quality improvement.
surface.contact_ik: Source-ankle two-link IK with pelvis-aligned anatomical knee poles, strictly one-axis knees, bounded ankles and floor clearance; no vertex warping

scope: Selected qualitative demonstration. 4 complete targets on one continuous player. Display-only position/rotation smoothing, anatomical reconstruction and floor retargeting; raw native features, ownership and actual timing retained. No within-action cuts, speedup, or benchmark updates.
language: Chinese authored instructions with actual English model-input translations; not a native Chinese-language benchmark

review.review_method: Full-trace numerical articulation and ownership checks; visual inspection of target progressions, critical-motion and transition contact sheets.
